difficulty_reason: For an immersion i : X -> Y of schemes, if i is perfect, Y is locally Noetherian, and the conormal sheaf C_{X/Y} is finite locally free, then i is a regular immersion. The retained proof is the author's directive: 'translated into algebra, this is Divided Power Algebra, proposition regular-ideal' — the ring statement that a quasi-regular (here perfect plus conormal-free forces the Koszul-regular grade count) ideal of finite projective conormal in a Noetherian setting is generated by a regular sequence, quoted by name; the Noetherian hypothesis is consumed by that proposition, and no additional scheme argument is written. Retained author proof at lines 18453-18456.
